# Home Insurance

Combined buildings and contents with Thornbury, renewed each May. Two policies were
held separately until 2025, when they were combined; older documents therefore
reference two policy numbers rather than one.

## Policy

- Policy number: HM-4471902-C
- Buildings cover: 485,000
- Contents cover: 75,000, single item limit 2,500
- Excess: 350 standard, 1,000 subsidence
- Renewal date: 19 May 2027

## Claims

One claim, in 2025, for a escape of water from the upstairs bathroom. Settled at
4,180 against a 350 excess. The claim is disclosable on every subsequent policy
renewal for five years.
